top_starred.name: affaan-m/ECC
top_starred.desc: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
top_starred.tagline: AI编程助手性能优化系统，让AI更聪明高效
top_starred.explanation: 这个项目是一个给AI编程助手（比如Claude Code、Codex等）用的性能优化系统。它解决的是AI编程助手在干活时不够聪明、容易出错、记不住事情的问题。它给AI加上了技能、直觉、记忆和安全保护，让AI能更好地理解你的需求，干活更靠谱。普通人可能用不上，但如果你是程序员，用AI写代码时觉得AI不够聪明，可以试试这个系统来提升AI的表现。上手需要一些技术知识，适合有编程经验的人。

top_starred.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
top_starred.desc: The agent that grows with you
top_starred.tagline: 能陪你成长的AI助手，越用越懂你
top_starred.explanation: 这个项目是一个AI助手，特点是会随着你的使用而成长。它解决的是传统AI助手一成不变、不懂你个人需求的问题。它会学习你的习惯和偏好，逐渐变得更懂你。比如，你经常让它帮你整理日程，它就会越来越擅长，甚至主动提醒你。普通人也能用，上手不难，就像用聊天软件一样。适合想要一个贴心AI助手的人，但需要一些耐心让它慢慢学习。

top_starred.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
top_starred.desc: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.
top_starred.tagline: 让每个人都能用的AI自动化工具
top_starred.explanation: AutoGPT是一个开源项目，目标是让AI自动化变得简单，让不懂技术的人也能用。它解决的是AI使用门槛高的问题，让AI能自己完成复杂任务，比如自动写报告、做市场调研等。普通人可以把它当作一个智能助手，告诉它目标，它自己拆解步骤去完成。比如，你想了解某个行业的最新动态，它可以自动搜索、整理成报告。上手有点难度，需要一些学习，但社区有很多教程。

top_starred.name: ollama/ollama
top_starred.desc: Get up and running with Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
top_starred.tagline: 一键运行各种大模型的工具
top_starred.explanation: Ollama是一个工具，让你能在自己的电脑上轻松运行各种AI大模型，比如DeepSeek、Qwen等。它解决的是普通人想用AI但不会配置环境的问题。你只需要下载安装，然后选择模型就能用，就像安装软件一样简单。比如，你可以用它运行一个聊天机器人，或者本地跑一个写作助手，不用联网，隐私安全。适合想体验AI但不想折腾技术的人，上手非常简单。

top_starred.name: f/prompts.chat
top_starred.desc: f.k.a. Awesome ChatGPT Prompts. Share, discover, and collect prompts from the community. Free and open source — self-host for your organization with complete privacy.
top_starred.tagline: 收集和分享AI提示词的社区
top_starred.explanation: 这个项目是一个收集和分享AI提示词（prompts）的社区，提示词就是你给AI的指令。它解决的是很多人不知道怎么跟AI说话才能得到好结果的问题。你可以在这里找到别人分享的高质量提示词，比如写简历、写诗、做翻译等，直接复制使用。普通人也能用，不需要技术背景，就像逛论坛一样。适合所有用AI工具的人，能让你更高效地使用AI。

trending.name: powerycy/goutoujunshi
trending.desc: 一个先接住情绪、再分析关系并给出可执行策略的 Codex 恋爱军师，内置心理、法律、社会、人文、哲学、婚姻家庭与性学知识库，支持多元关系。

trending.explanation: 这个项目是一个AI恋爱军师，专门帮你分析感情问题并给出建议。它解决的是感情问题中情绪化和不知所措的困扰。它会先接住你的情绪，再分析你和对方的关系，然后给出具体可执行的策略。比如，你和伴侣吵架了，它可以帮你分析原因，建议怎么沟通。内置了心理学、法律等知识库，支持各种关系类型。适合在感情中遇到困惑的人，上手简单，就像聊天一样。

trending.name: makecindy/cindy
trending.desc: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。

trending.explanation: Cindy是一个开源的AI助手，特点是开箱即用，不需要复杂配置。它解决的是AI工具使用复杂的问题，让你直接就能用。你可以让它帮你完成各种任务，比如写邮件、安排日程、查资料等。比如，你说“帮我订明天下午的会议室”，它就能自动操作。适合非技术用户，上手非常简单，就像用手机助手一样。适合想提高效率的普通人。

trending.name: hahhforest/pi-textbook

trending.name: 0xwilliamortiz/openclaude-improved
trending.tagline: 让AI助手在任何地方都能用
trending.explanation: 这个项目是一个改进版的AI助手，特点是可以在任何地方运行，使用任何工具。它解决的是AI助手受限于特定平台或工具的问题。比如，你可以在不同的软件里使用它，还能让它调用各种外部工具。适合喜欢折腾的技术爱好者，需要一些配置，但灵活性很高。普通人可能用不上，但程序员会觉得很有用。

trending.name: mikehasa/agentacct
trending.desc: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
trending.tagline: 监控AI编程助手的工作和花费
trending.explanation: 这个项目是一个本地监控工具，让你看到你的AI编程助手做了什么、花了多少钱。它解决的是AI编程助手使用不透明的问题。它会记录AI的每一步操作，比如用了什么工具、改了哪些文件、花了多少时间和token（AI计费单位）。比如，你可以看到AI写代码时用了哪些工具，花了多少费用。适合用AI编程的人，尤其是需要控制成本的企业，上手简单，本地运行，保护隐私。

spaces.name: cinderholm/wan2-2-i2v-v3
spaces.tagline: 用一张图生成视频的AI工具
spaces.explanation: 这个工具是Wan2.2模型的最新预览版，专门用来把静态图片变成动态视频。你只需要提供一张图片，再输入一段文字描述，它就能生成一段短视频。比如你有一张风景照，输入“下雨了”，它就能生成下雨的动态效果。对于普通人来说，可以用来制作有趣的社交媒体内容，或者帮助理解AI视频生成技术。上手很简单，直接在网页上操作，不需要安装任何软件，也不需要懂编程。对于学英语的人，可以尝试用英文描述来生成视频，顺便练习英语表达。

spaces.name: kulkas2pintu/wan555
spaces.desc: generate a video from an image with a text prompt
spaces.tagline: 从图片和文字生成视频的工具
spaces.explanation: 这个工具和第一个类似，也是根据图片和文字提示生成视频。它的特点是操作简单，界面友好，适合新手。你上传一张图片，输入你想看到的动作或场景，它就会生成对应的视频片段。比如你有一张宠物照片，输入“宠物在奔跑”，就能得到宠物奔跑的视频。对于学生来说，可以用来制作学习演示视频，或者探索AI的创造力。上手难度低，不需要任何技术背景，只需要会打字和上传图片即可。

spaces.name: prithivMLmods/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-LoRAs-Fast
spaces.desc: Demo of the Collection of Qwen Image Edit LoRAs
spaces.tagline: 用LoRA技术编辑图片的演示
spaces.explanation: 这个工具展示了Qwen图像编辑LoRA模型的集合，LoRA是一种轻量级的模型微调技术，可以让AI快速学会新的编辑风格。你可以用它来编辑图片，比如改变图片的风格、添加元素或修改细节。例如，你可以上传一张普通照片，让它变成油画风格，或者给照片加上一个太阳。对于普通人，这是一个体验AI图像编辑的好机会，不需要任何编程知识。对于学英语的人，可以尝试用英文描述编辑效果，提高英语应用能力。上手简单，网页直接操作。

spaces.name: owensong/Inflect-v2
spaces.desc: Run complete 3.96M and 9.36M text-to-waveform models live.
spaces.tagline: 实时文字转语音的AI模型
spaces.explanation: 这个工具是Inflect-v2模型，能够将文字实时转换为语音，而且模型大小有3.96M和9.36M两个版本，适合不同需求。你可以输入一段文字，它就能生成自然流畅的语音。比如，你可以输入一段英文对话，它就会朗读出来，这对于学英语的人来说非常有用，可以练习听力和发音。对于普通人，可以用来制作有声书或语音提示。上手非常简单，直接输入文字即可，无需任何技术知识。

spaces.name: pliny-the-prompter/obliteratus
spaces.explanation: 这个工具叫做obliteratus，它提供了一键解锁模型的功能，并附带聊天界面。所谓“解锁”可能是指去除模型的一些限制，使其能更自由地生成内容。你可以直接和AI聊天，测试它的能力。比如，你可以问它各种问题，或者让它写故事、翻译等。对于新手，这是一个了解AI对话能力的好入口，不需要任何设置。上手非常简单，打开网页就能用。但要注意，解锁可能涉及伦理问题，使用时要遵守规定。

models.name: moonshotai/Kimi-K3
models.tagline: 支持图文输入的多模态AI模型
models.explanation: Kimi-K3是月之暗面公司开发的多模态模型，可以同时处理文字和图片。它能理解图片内容并回答相关问题，比如你上传一张数学题照片，它能帮你解题。对于学生，这是一个学习辅助工具，可以拍照提问。对于学英语的人，可以上传英文图片让它翻译或解释。上手难度中等，需要一些API知识，但普通用户可以通过平台使用。它代表了AI从纯文本向多模态发展的趋势。

models.name: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731

models.name: DavidAU/Qwen3.6-27B-Fable-Fusion-711-Uncensored-Heretic-NM-DAU-NEO-MAX-MTP-GGUF

models.name: baidu/Unlimited-OCR

models.name: owensong/Inflect-Micro-v2

models.explanation: Inflect-Micro-v2是Inflect的轻量版，专门用于文字转语音，模型更小，运行更快。你可以输入文字，它生成语音。比如，你可以用它来朗读英文文章，帮助学习。对于普通人，可以制作语音内容。上手简单，直接使用。它代表了AI模型向轻量化、高效化发展的趋势。

items.title_en: AskChem: Claim-Centered Infrastructure for Chemistry Literature Synthesis
items.summary: Chemistry literature synthesis often requires assembling specific findings scattered across many publications, yet existing literature-search systems primarily return ranked document lists. As a result, scientists and AI agents need to locate relevant information, verify their provenance, and assemble cross-paper answers manually. We present AskChem, a claim-centered infrastructure for cross-paper chemistry search. AskChem changes the unit of retrieval from the paper to the provenance-carrying c
items.title_cn: AskChem：面向化学文献综述的以声明为中心的基础设施
items.note: 将检索单位从论文改为带出处的声明，帮助科学家和AI代理跨论文整合信息，对化学领域AI应用有参考价值。

items.title_en: Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report: Toward Next-Generation Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
items.summary: GUI agents have the potential to become a general purpose executor over existing digital devices. To advance them toward real-world use, we envision agents that operate reliably on real devices, execute workflows across platforms, combine GUI interaction with CLI execution, complete long-horizon tasks, proactively initiate useful services, and autonomously improve their capabilities with minimal human effort. Guided by this vision, we present Qwen-UI-Agent, a real-world centric foundation GUI ag
items.title_cn: Qwen-UI-Agent技术报告：迈向下一代以真实世界为中心的GUI基础代理
items.note: 介绍一个能在真实设备上可靠操作、跨平台执行工作流的GUI代理，对AI代理落地有启发。

items.title_en: Metis: Memory Foundation Model
items.summary: Recent advances in AI agents have increasingly internalized native capabilities into their underlying foundation models, giving rise to multimodal foundation models and large reasoning models. However, agent memory is still primarily implemented through external modules, leaving the native memory capability largely unexplored. In this paper, we take a first step toward this direction by introducing memory foundation models, which empower foundation models with native memory capabilities. We form
items.title_cn: Metis：记忆基础模型
items.note: 首次提出让基础模型具备原生记忆能力，而非依赖外部模块，对AI代理长期记忆研究有开创性。

items.title_en: PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language
items.summary: We introduce PhiZero, a physical world model built around physical language, a compact discrete representation of world-state transitions. Existing physical world models typically predict future videos directly in pixel space, leaving the underlying world dynamics implicit within high-dimensional visual predictors. Motivated by humans' ability to abstract predictive structure from visual experience and organize it in natural language for explicit reasoning, we learn physical language from in-the
items.title_cn: PhiZero：围绕物理语言构建的世界模型
items.note: 用紧凑离散的物理语言表示世界状态转换，而非直接预测像素，提高世界模型的可解释性。

items.title_en: Frontis-MA1: Training an AI4AI Model towards Recursive Self-Improvement in Machine Learning Engineering
items.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires AI systems that improve the process of building AI (i.e., AI4AI); machine learning engineering (MLE) offers a concrete, executable testbed for studying this capability. We introduce OpenMLE, an open full-stack system for RSI research in MLE, spanning verifiable task environments with execution feedback (OpenMLE-Gym), operator learning (OpenMLE-RL), and long-horizon search (OpenMLE-Evo). On this stack we post-train Frontis-MA1 (35B) as a meta-evolution ag
items.title_cn: Frontis-MA1：训练AI4AI模型实现机器学习工程的递归自我改进
items.note: 提出OpenMLE系统，训练模型在机器学习工程中自我改进，对AI自我进化研究有贡献。

items.title_en: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
items.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models commonly adopt an LLM-centric V to L to A pathway, where visual observations are projected into the representation space of a large language model before being decoded into robot actions. Although effective, this design incurs substantial computation and memory overhead at every policy invocation. In this work, we introduce TurboVLA, a new VLA paradigm that reformulates the conventional V to L to A pathway as a direct V + L to A mapping. Instead of using a lar
items.title_cn: TurboVLA：在RTX 4090上以32Hz实时运行的视觉-语言-动作模型
items.note: 重新设计VLA范式，直接映射视觉+语言到动作，大幅降低计算和内存开销，适合机器人实时控制。

items.title_en: DistillAlign: Coordinating Mode Covering and Mode Seeking in Autoregressive Video Distillation
items.summary: Existing autoregressive video distillation methods commonly adopt a Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD)-based multi-stage pipeline. However, they typically decouple the initialization and DMD stages -- which then pursue different target distributions -- and judge the intermediate student mainly by visual scores such as VBench. In this paper, we revisit this design from a distributional perspective. Given the mode-seeking nature of the distribution matching loss, a good initialization should
items.title_cn: DistillAlign：自回归视频蒸馏中模式覆盖与模式寻求的协调
items.note: 从分布角度改进视频蒸馏，协调初始化与蒸馏阶段，提升生成质量。

items.title_en: CoRT: Counterfactual Replay for Token-Level Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization
items.summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning enriches language model training by evaluating model outputs against explicit criteria. Yet in GRPO-style pipelines, these structured judgments are reduced to a scalar response-level reward and converted into a response-level advantage, which is broadcast uniformly to all generated tokens. This leaves no explicit mechanism for allocating credit within a response, even when different criteria are grounded in different spans, formatting decisions, or semantic ch
items.title_cn: CoRT：基于反事实重放和令牌级评分准则的策略优化
items.note: 在GRPO风格训练中，为每个令牌分配基于评分准则的信用，提升语言模型训练效率。

items.title_en: HumanCLAW: Can Vision-Language Models Act Through a Body?
items.summary: Evaluating whether a vision-language model (VLM) can act through a physical body is challenging. The outcome of an action couples the VLM's decision with motor control. When a task fails, it is hard to tell whether the VLM made a bad choice or the motor controller simply failed to execute it, e.g., losing balance and falling. In this work, we introduce HumanCLAW, an evaluation framework that decouples action decision-making from low-level execution. At every step, a harnessed, off-the-shelf VLM
items.title_cn: HumanCLAW：视觉语言模型能否通过身体行动？
items.note: 提出评估框架，将决策与执行解耦，测试VLM在物理世界中的行动能力。

items.title_en: DecoEvo: Score-Decoupled Co-Evolution of Solver and Rubric-Generator Skills in Text Space
items.summary: Text-space optimization adapts large language models (LLMs) by editing external natural-language artifacts rather than model weights, so the optimized artifacts remain inspectable and the model can be treated as a black box. However, most existing text-space methods keep evaluation fixed. On open-ended tasks, this can become a bottleneck: once the solver improves on the criteria a rubric measures, omitted dimensions remain invisible to the optimization signal. Simply evolving the rubric is also
items.title_cn: DecoEvo：文本空间中求解器与评分生成器的分数解耦协同进化
items.note: 在文本空间优化LLM，同时进化求解器和评分生成器，避免评估瓶颈。

items.title_en: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
items.summary: Learning deployable manipulation policies is bottlenecked by the scarcity of data that is both high-fidelity and scalable. Real-robot teleoperation is accurate but costly to scale; robot-free UMI capture scales readily, and current practice uses the resulting data mainly for pre-training, adding a small real-robot "anchor" at post-training. We ask whether raising the fidelity of robot-free UMI data, rather than shrinking the real-robot fraction, can remove that anchor. We present HiFi-UMI, a por
items.title_cn: HiFi-UMI：仅从高保真UMI数据学习可部署的操控策略
items.note: 提高无机器人数据保真度，无需真实机器人锚点，降低操控策略学习成本。

items.title_en: CodeNib: A Multi-View Data System for Serving Repository Context to Coding Agents
items.summary:
Coding agents repeatedly search, navigate, and retain context from evolving repositories, but disconnected indexes, language servers, and task-local histories force repeated discovery and obscure lifecycle costs. CodeNib builds reusable lexical, dense, and structural views per repository commit, maps outputs to repository-relative source ranges, maintains selected views across edits, and serves ranked search, symbol navigation, and bounded context through one runtime.
  Across 100 snapshots, we
items.title_cn: CodeNib：为编码代理提供仓库上下文的多视图数据系统
items.note: 构建可复用的词法、稠密和结构视图，高效服务编码代理的上下文检索。

items.title_en: A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search
items.summary: Relevance is a query-dependent estimate of whether a document or excerpt contains useful evidence. Existing retrieval agents use relevance to select top-k content, but document relevance alone cannot localize, compose, or verify the evidence required by complex questions. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) enables such fine-grained operations through grep-style exploration, but its relevance-agnostic search can expose useful clues late and delay convergence. Recent advances use relevance to narrow
items.title_cn: 相关性的新角色：引导代理搜索中的语料库交互
items.note: 利用相关性指导细粒度语料库操作，加速复杂问题的证据定位。

items.title_en: ReDesign: Recovering Editable Design Structures from Images via Agentic Decomposition
items.summary: Recovering an editable design file from a raster image is a common and costly bottleneck in modern design workflows, yet remains challenging since editability depends on recovering multi-modal attributes, such as typography, vector geometry, colors, grouping, and layer ordering. We present ReDesign, an agentic framework that grows an editable layer hierarchy by selecting and composing specialized tools across modalities. To keep this long decision process reliable despite imperfect tool outputs,
items.title_cn: ReDesign：通过代理分解从图像恢复可编辑设计结构
items.note: 代理框架组合多模态工具，从栅格图像恢复可编辑的设计文件，提升设计工作流效率。

items.title_en: Keep It InMind: Benchmarking the Implicit-Association Blind Spot in Agent Memory
items.summary: Long-term memory systems store what a user says in an external store and retrieve it when a related query arrives. This interface rests on an assumption so natural that it is rarely stated: a memory that is needed will resemble the query that needs it. World knowledge breaks the assumption. A tree-nut allergy should change the answer to a macaron request through their almond-flour ingredient, yet the two texts share no cue a retriever can see. We call this failure mode the implicit-association b
items.title_cn: Keep It InMind：基准测试代理记忆中的隐式关联盲点
items.note: 指出记忆检索依赖表面相似性，无法处理隐式关联，如过敏原与配料的关系。

items.title_en: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
items.summary: We introduce Kimi K3, a 2.8T parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 104 billion activated parameters, native vision capabilities, and a 1-million-token context window. Kimi K3 is built on Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, which improve information flow across sequence length and model depth. Together with Stable LatentMoE, which effectively activates 16 of 896 routed experts per token, and refined training and data recipes, these advances yield an approximately 2.5x improvement in o
items.title_cn: Kimi K3：开放前沿智能
items.note: 2.8T参数MoE模型，原生视觉和百万上下文，性能大幅提升，代表前沿大模型进展。

items.title_en: Progress Reward Modeling for Robotic Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
items.summary: Robotic learning takes place in dynamic environments with large behavior spaces. A terminal success signal only tells the robot whether the task is completed. It does not explain whether the current behavior is making progress, remaining unchanged, or undoing earlier progress. For this reason, recent studies have increasingly explored progress rewards that provide feedback during task execution. However, the current literature lacks a shared framework. Existing methods use different observations
items.title_cn: 机器人学习的进度奖励建模：综合综述
items.note: 综述机器人学习中进度奖励的方法，提供统一框架，对机器人学习研究有参考价值。

items.title_en: JarvisHub: An Open Harness for Canvas-Native Multimodal Creative Agents
items.summary: Creative AI is moving from single-step asset generation toward long-horizon multimodal production. Although recent generative models can synthesize high-quality images, videos, audio clips, UI elements, storyboards, slides, and other creative assets, real-world creative work requires more than isolated prompt-output interactions. It involves references, drafts, alternatives, edits, failed attempts, version relations, tool actions, evaluation signals, and human feedback, which together form an ev
items.title_cn: JarvisHub：画布原生多模态创意代理的开放工具
items.note: 为长周期多模态创意生产提供开放工具，支持引用、草稿、版本等复杂工作流。

items.title_en: From Proprietary to Open-Source: Bridging the Distribution Gap via Multi-Agent Protocol Distillation in Agentic Search
items.summary: Agentic search enables large language models to solve knowledge-intensive tasks by interleaving multi-step reasoning with retrieval, yet optimizing this with outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) provides only sparse supervision. Knowledge distillation can supply denser guidance, and advanced proprietary models with their strong reasoning capabilities are promising teachers. While distilling from proprietary models can densify this supervisory signal, conventional logit-matching is precluded
items.title_cn: 从专有到开源：通过多代理协议蒸馏弥合分布差距
items.note: 从专有模型蒸馏协议到开源模型，提升代理搜索性能，避免直接logit匹配。

items.title_en: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) adapts diffusion models by querying a teacher along trajectories generated by the current student, but how it should behave under classifier-free guidance (CFG), a default component of modern diffusion systems, remains poorly understood. Existing OPD methods naturally extend velocity matching to the CFG-composed prediction, directly matching teacher and student guided velocities. We show that this objective is under-identified at the branch level: positive- and negat
items.title_cn: 重新思考策略扩散蒸馏中的无分类器引导
items.note: 分析CFG在策略蒸馏中的行为，指出目标欠定问题，提出改进方向。

items.title_en: DataPrep-Bench: Benchmarking LLMs as Training Data Preparators
items.summary: The quality of training data fundamentally determines the capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet no unified benchmark exists to measure how well LLMs, agents, and data-centric workflows actually prepare training data end to end. We view LLM-driven data preparation as comprising two complementary capabilities: data construction, which transforms raw sources into supervised training data, and data quality evaluation, which predicts the training value of candidate datasets before downstr
items.title_cn: DataPrep-Bench：基准测试LLM作为训练数据准备者
items.note: 统一基准衡量LLM在数据构建和质量评估上的能力，对数据工程有参考价值。

items.title_en: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
items.summary: LLM training is shifting from manual design and annotation to interaction-driven self-evolution. However, existing self-evolutionary methods face a fundamental dilemma between task diversity and verification reliability: environment-bound methods obtain precise feedback but confine learning to narrow domains, while open-ended self-generation broadens the task space but lacks reliable verification, allowing misleading rewards to pollute the training loop. We identify agent skills as a powerful mi
items.title_cn: 技能自博弈：通过协同进化技能推动LLM能力前沿
items.note: 通过技能自博弈平衡任务多样性和验证可靠性，促进LLM自我进化。

items.title_en: Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Agentic reinforcement learning research is constant algorithm modification, new estimators, new pipeline stages, new rollout schemes, and in mainstream frameworks each change threads through layers of trainer, distributed backend, and rollout glue: the cost lands on the researcher at every iteration. Molt is a PyTorch-native training framework built to keep that cost small: a codebase compact and clean enough for a researcher to hold in their head, and for an AI coding assistant to read and reas
items.title_cn: Molt：用于代理强化学习的可扩展PyTorch原生训练框架
items.note: 简洁的PyTorch框架，降低代理RL研究中的实现成本，便于快速迭代。

items.title_en: Scaling Native Multimodal Pre-Training From Scratch
items.summary: Although large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable reasoning capabilities, their reliance on text-only pre-training restricts the perception of the multimodal physical world. Native multimodal pre-training avoids this limitation by training models from scratch on multimodal inputs, thereby achieving deep cross-modal integration and mitigating optimization asymmetries inherent to traditional late-fusion architectures. Despite these advantages, the scaling properties of this paradigm remain
items.title_cn: 从零开始扩展原生多模态预训练
items.note: 研究原生多模态预训练的扩展规律，避免后期融合的优化不对称问题。

items.title_en: Agentic Context Management: Solving Agent Memory and Cost by Treating Them as Lifecycle and Architecture Problems
items.summary: Production AI agents' failures are less often due to an inability to reason well and more often because they cannot manage what is in their reasoning context: conversation histories, large prompts, large tool definitions, and ballooning tool outputs. Agents drown in their own accumulating history while paying a token cost that grows every turn, producing missing recalls within and across conversations. The incumbent response treats this as a storage-and-retrieval problem. We argue that framing i
items.title_cn: 代理上下文管理：将记忆和成本视为生命周期和架构问题
items.note: 将代理记忆问题重新定义为生命周期和架构问题，而非存储检索问题。

items.title_en: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
items.summary: Deep research requires agents to find answers that jointly satisfy multiple constraints. Discovering such answers is costly, whereas verifying a candidate can often be decomposed into tractable constraint-wise checks. This discovery--verification asymmetry suggests that a research agent should do more than simply search longer: it should recursively improve its current answer by verifying intermediate results and using the partially verified state to guide subsequent refinement. We introduce ARE
items.title_cn: AREX：迈向递归自我改进的深度研究代理
items.note: 利用发现-验证不对称性，递归改进答案，提升深度研究效率。

items.title_en: K12-KGraph: A Curriculum-Aligned Knowledge Graph for Benchmarking and Training Educational LLMs
items.summary: Large language models are increasingly used in K-12 education, but existing benchmarks mainly test exam question answering rather than understanding how curriculum knowledge is structured and visually presented. We call this capability curriculum cognition. It covers prerequisite chains, concept taxonomies, experiment-concept links, pedagogical sequencing, and visual grounding. We introduce K12-KGraph, a curriculum-aligned knowledge graph extracted from official People's Education Press textbook
items.title_cn: K12-KGraph：用于基准测试和训练教育LLM的课程对齐知识图谱
items.note: 从教材构建知识图谱，测试LLM的课程认知能力，对教育AI有参考价值。

items.title_en: ReferTrack: Referring Then Tracking for Embodied Visual Tracking
items.summary: Embodied visual tracking (EVT) requires a mobile agent to continuously follow a specific target described in natural language using only onboard vision. While recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies unify target identification and trajectory planning, their chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning often operates in abstract spatial latents that are difficult to supervise and weakly aligned with explicit image-space detections. To address this, we introduce ReferTrack, a referring-then-tracking para
items.title_cn: ReferTrack：具身视觉跟踪中的先引用后跟踪
items.note: 将目标识别和轨迹规划解耦，先引用再跟踪，提升具身视觉跟踪性能。

items.title_en: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
items.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is promising as it removes the external teacher required by on-policy distillation (OPD), yet it still needs asymmetric information between teacher and student to ensure that the self-teacher provides a stronger learning signal than the student. Existing methods create this asymmetry either through privileged answers or visual evidence. We ask whether both can be removed, yielding a simpler form of OPSD driven purely by input conditioning. For this purpose, we
items.title_cn: 视觉对比自蒸馏
items.note: 简化自蒸馏，仅通过输入条件创建不对称性，无需特权答案或视觉证据。

items.title_en: SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation
items.summary: We introduce SANA-Video 2.0, a hybrid video diffusion transformer instantiated at 5B and 14B scales under a unified architecture. Designed to generate high-quality video up to 720p on a single GPU, SANA-Video 2.0 matches full-softmax video DiTs in quality while retaining the favorable long-sequence scaling of linear attention. To avoid quadratic attention throughout, Hybrid Linear-Softmax Attention combines gated linear attention for O(N)-dominated mixing with periodic gated-softmax anchors at a
items.title_cn: SANA-Video 2.0：混合线性注意力与注意力残差的高效视频生成
items.note: 混合线性-softmax注意力，在单GPU上生成720p视频，兼顾质量和效率。

items.title_en: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD
items.summary: Full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter-scale MoE models introduces substantial system-level challenges for large-scale distributed training, including severe memory pressure, non-overlapped communication overhead, and inefficient kernel execution. While most large-scale LLM training systems are built around GPU-based clusters, this report presents an end-to-end optimization practice on the Ascend NPU SuperPOD. Using the DeepSeek-V4 model family as the target workload, we develop a hi
items.title_cn: SLAI T-Rex：在昇腾SuperPOD上对DeepSeek-V4系列进行全参数后训练
items.note: 针对昇腾NPU优化万亿参数MoE模型的全参数后训练，解决内存和通信瓶颈。

items.title_en: Self Gradient Forcing: Native Long Video Extrapolation
items.summary: Recent autoregressive video diffusion methods are increasingly built upon Self Forcing, where the student is trained on histories produced by its own rollout rather than ground-truth video contexts. This reduces exposure bias, but the historical key-value cache is still used by future frames only as frozen rollout state. As a result, future losses cannot supervise how earlier generated latents should be written into more useful keys and values for later video-latent generation. We call this the
items.title_cn: 自梯度强制：原生长视频外推
items.note: 改进自强制方法，让未来损失监督历史键值缓存，提升长视频生成能力。

items.title_en: Beyond Relevance-Centric Retrieval: Rubric-Oriented Document Set Selection and Ranking
items.summary: As large language models and AI agents become the primary consumers of search results, document set quality determines the upper bound of downstream generation. Yet existing evaluation systems remain confined to scoring documents independently and aggregating via nDCG, ignoring inter-document interactions (redundancy, conflict, complementarity) and unable to answer what makes one document set better than another. To address these issues, we propose a complete evaluate-diagnose-optimize framework
items.title_cn: 超越相关性中心检索：面向评分准则的文档集选择与排序
items.note: 考虑文档间交互，优化文档集整体质量，而非独立评分。

items.title_en: An Exam for Active Observers
items.summary: Human vision is a closed loop: gaze is continuously redirected by intermediate hypotheses rather than a single snapshot. Decades of psychophysics and cognitive science have argued that this active observation is essential for a wide range of tasks. Whether today's multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exercise active observation is an empirical question that current vision-language benchmarks do not answer. We introduce ActiveVision, a benchmark that makes active observation measurable for ML
items.title_cn: 主动观察者的考试
items.note: 提出ActiveVision基准，衡量多模态LLM的主动观察能力，填补现有基准空白。

items.title_en: Scaling Laws for Hypernetwork-Based Knowledge Injection in Large Language Models
items.summary: Injecting factual knowledge into large language models (LLMs) reliably and at scale remains an open challenge. Hypernetworks provide a promising solution to large-scale knowledge injection. Although hypernetworks are typically applied for test-time adaptation, we explore their use in train-time knowledge injection, where, given a large corpus of facts, we train a hypernetwork to generate a fixed LoRA adapter that, when inserted into the target model, enable the model to answer questions about th
items.title_cn: 基于超网络的大语言模型知识注入的扩展规律
items.note: 探索超网络在训练时知识注入的扩展规律，为大规模知识注入提供指导。

huggingface.models_summary: 这些热门模型反映了AI向多模态、轻量化和高效化发展的趋势。Kimi-K3和Qwen3.6支持图文输入，说明AI能处理更丰富的信息；DeepSeek-V4-Flash追求速度，适合实时应用；Unlimited-OCR和Inflect-Micro-v2则展示了AI在文档和语音方面的实用功能。对于想跟进AI圈的人，要注意多模态和轻量化是未来方向，备考AI方向时，可以多关注这些技术。同时，这些模型也体现了开源和社区微调的趋势，比如Qwen3.6的定制版本。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文主要围绕AI代理、多模态模型、强化学习、知识注入等方向，热门话题包括代理记忆与上下文管理、自我改进与进化、高效视频生成、机器人学习等。新手应记住的关键词有：代理（Agent）、多模态、强化学习、知识图谱、扩散模型、MoE、上下文管理、自我进化。
